question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank No. 5.
solution:
The correct answer is '**light**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The passage describes a ruined castle with tall black windows that show no source of light.
 
• The appropriate word should refer to the absence of illumination or brightness, which fits well with the context of dark windows.
 
• "Light" fits because it refers to the absence of any brightness or ray coming from the windows of the castle.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 2**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Hopeless (निराश): "Hopeless" refers to a lack of hope or possibility, which does not make sense in the context of describing a dark scene without light.
 
• Electricity (बिजली): "Electricity" refers to a power source and does not fit the meaning of describing light in the absence of illumination.
 
• Time (समय): "Time" refers to a period or moment and does not relate to light or darkness in the context of the passage.
